top_signals.title: Tech Under Pressure Ahead of Anthropic IPO, Stock Selloff Continues
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Alger’s Executive Vice President, Portfolio Manager Ankur Crawford, Bilt’s CEO Ankur Jain, Jefferies’ Senior Equity Research Analyst Sheila Kahyaoglu, Betterment’s CEO Sarah Levy, Citi Wealth’s Head of Portfolio Strategy J.P. Coviello, Fortalice Solutions’ CEO Theresa Payton, Shamrock Capital’s Co-President and Partner Mike LaSalle, Shamrock Capital’s Partner Jason Sklar, Former NFL Player and Athletes.org’s CEO and Co-founder Brandon Copeland, and Learfield’s President and CEO Cole Gahagan. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
